1. i was holding the flashlight for him in the cold garage, trying to keep the beam perfectly still. 2. we never talked much during these projects. just the click of a socket wrench and the smell of lawnmower gas. 3. he was trying to fix a small engine that had been dead since july, his knuckles gray with dust. 4. usually, this is where he would tell me to check my oil, or ask if i had enough money for groceries. 5. but he stopped, wiped his grease-stained hands on a yellow rag, and looked at the wall. 6. without turning around, he said, i'm really glad you came home. 7. we stood there in the cold for another hour, and for once, i didn't mind holding the light.
✍️ Caption
some people don't have the words until they are standing in a drafty garage with grease on their hands. send this to him. #dad #growingup #family #home
